#### ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Load packages

```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)   
tidymodels_prefer()   
```


#### ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Model Assessment

### Confusion matrix and Classification Metrics

```{r}
# create confusion matrix (rows = predicted class, columns = true class)

knn_cm <- default_test_preds |>
  conf_mat(truth = __________, estimate = __________)

knn_cm

```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3.5

autoplot(knn_cm, type = "heatmap")

```


```{r}
# metrics computed from the confusion matrix ("Yes" is the event)

summary(knn_cm)

```



### ROC curve and AUC

```{r}
#| fig-align: "center"
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5

# ROC curve: uses the PROBABILITY of the event, not the class labels

knn_roc <- default_test_preds |>
  roc_curve(truth = __________, __________)

knn_roc   # one row per threshold

autoplot(knn_roc)

```

```{r}
# obtain AUC

default_test_preds |>
  roc_auc(truth = __________, __________)

```
